options._note: B260 is live from the church door (M000 ch10 f60 'Jamie, are you all right?') to the end of the game: ch10 f60-73, ch11-15 and the ending. These cards sat in subs_B250.json (B250 = ch9 f83-86 + ch10 f1-59) and never drew (BUG-050's class: a bank goes live with an empty cue file). Both blobs take the second (18-wide) wrap again: 14 KB and 44 KB of the 48 KB cap - the 508-cue file could not. The ending (the airport: Jamie's farewell, Metal Gear's stopgap body) is S000 ch5 f2, 121 s, cards B260_e_*; ch5 f3 (53 s) carries the closing narration in its last 14 s ('Doubt. It has always bred conflict...' - whisper hears it only on a centre-extracted signal), but the game types that narration itself in green over black (its ISZ text), so it gets no cards - voice over game text; ch2 f1 is the credits' music.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Dr. Petrovich Madnar, a robotics specialist.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: His son Elijah Madnar, genetic engineering and microbiology.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: My fields were nanobiology and picobiology.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Gillian, behavioral physiology and psychopathology.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You remember me? I am Elijah Madnar, Petrovich Madnar's only son.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Elijah himself. Though I've grown old and frail.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Fifty years ago, we worked

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: on a top-secret project in the Soviet Union.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The Cold War still divided East and West.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Everyone lived in fear of nuclear war.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The communist bloc was facing an economic crisis.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Democratic and nationalist movements were rising.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The survival of socialism was at stake.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: A treaty to halt nuclear arms production was expected soon.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Meanwhile, America and the other military

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: powers were entering an arms race in space.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The world's military balance had reached its limit.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: It was a naive age.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The great powers' leaders believed military

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: force alone could make their nations stronger.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Snatcher Project.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Secretly replace enemy VIPs with Kremlin puppets.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Control their politics and economies,

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: and spread communism and socialism from within.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: They'd apparently been held here for three years

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: to develop artificial skin for the Snatchers. One was his own father.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: They gathered brilliant scientists

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: from around the world to develop the Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Some were brought there by force.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Development began in Neo Akademgorodok, in Novosibirsk.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Then it moved beneath the Kremlin.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Perestroika and glasnost were fueling calls for democracy.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: So the conservatives hid us underground.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: You were an intelligence agent sent by the CIA, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Your mission was to sabotage the project.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: A huge explosion struck Chernoton Laboratory. The cause was unknown.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: A germ weapon under development escaped into the air.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: It destroyed the country and the project.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: But the Kremlin's conservative tyrants thought differently.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: They sought military supremacy

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: through a completely different approach.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The reformers were gaining ground.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The Kremlin conservatives were desperate.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: So they launched that childish scheme.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: We entered cold sleep in a shelter beneath the Kremlin,

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: until the bacteria would become harmless.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Elijah, why would you do this?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Dr. Petrovich just died.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: What? My father?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I see. My father is dead.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: During the chaos of the Catastrophe, Dr. Petrovich

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: and our son Harry were miraculously rescued by the American government.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Don't you remember Dr. Petrovich? Dr. Petrovich Madnar.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: At the top was our team: the Frankenstein Project team.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Then, on June 6, 1991, the accident happened.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Fifty years later, three years ago, the 17th expedition found us.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: All right, Gillian. I'll tell you about that terrible past.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The reformers joined forces with America to stop the project.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It's been a long time, Jamie. And you, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Tell me, Jamie. Who am I? What were we doing in the Kremlin?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Four scientists led by Dr. Petrovich Madnar, who lies here now.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Our government must know about that.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: That's why they assigned you to JUNKER.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I was happy.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Despite all the political turmoil, every day was fulfilling.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: My father trusted me. Jamie watched over me.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I worked desperately to complete my research.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I was still young,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: an electronics research student just starting out.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: My father's connections got me into the Snatcher Project.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: That's where I met you, Jamie.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You were my father Petrovich's assistant.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: That's when I learned you were a CIA agent, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: And you, Gillian, were planning to secretly hand our research

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: over to your country's military.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It was a cash deal with your government.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Artificial skin didn't need T lymphocytes,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Langerhans cells or endocrine cells.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: We needed keratinocytes and pigment cells: melanocytes.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The reformist leaders wanted to hide this insane project.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: They ordered us to dispose of all our research materials.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Then they planned to put us on trial.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The bioroids were 80 percent complete.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The core endoskeleton was nearly finished.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: but the artificial skin was not.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: That was my work, and Jamie's.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Artificial protein technology was too limited back then.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Synthesizing real cells was extremely difficult.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Research like that took years.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Fifty years ago in Moscow, I was obsessed.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: With my research, and with you, Jamie.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Even so, my feelings only grew stronger.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: My father worried about me.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: He tried to take me off the project, but I wouldn't let go.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Your beauty captivated me, Jamie. Your smile filled my heart.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You had something the women of the East didn't.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I was young and withdrawn, but you slowly opened my heart.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I couldn't stop my feelings.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The Cold War between East and West ended.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The conservatives behind the project lost power.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The Frankenstein Project was canceled.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I wasn't a politician. I didn't care what happened to the state.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: My research and Jamie were my whole world.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You appeared, Gillian. You came into our lives.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: And everything fell apart.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You and Jamie fell in love, married and had a child.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I was about to lose it all.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You can't imagine the shock that was to a young man.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: That year, the wave of democracy

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: that swept Eastern Europe spread throughout our country.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: But even that small happiness didn't last.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Far from home, Jamie quickly grew close to Gillian,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: her fellow countryman.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The original plan was to Snatch an entire country at once.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: We had to replace a whole nation or city in a single night.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Neo Kobe was cut off from the outside world.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Ideal for simulating a miniature nation.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Its mix of ethnic groups also made it ideal

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: for gathering a wide range of data on Snatching.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: After I sealed off the institute, I entered cold sleep in an

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: underground shelter with you two, who had failed to escape.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I left a satellite to monitor the atmosphere.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: We would wake automatically

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: when Lucifer Alpha became harmless.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: And back then, I couldn't have persuaded Jamie.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It wasn't time yet. I reset your timers to infinity.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: But Jamie was always sleeping beside me.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I spoke to you for forty years,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: in that dark underground shelter.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: For forty years, I worked alone in the darkness beneath

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: the Kremlin, developing the bioroids' artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: No, it worked. I woke exactly ten years later. Before you two, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I planned to wake only Jamie,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: so we could finish the bioroids together.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You would sleep forever, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: On June 6, I acted, after moving the bioroid research materials

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: and records into the shelter.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: So another team was developing a germ weapon alongside the Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Reliable and fast-acting,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: able to kill an entire population in an instant.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Day after day, no visitors. No sunlight.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: No changing colors of the seasons.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Exactly. The RA011 virus, developed by another team.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I chose Neo Kobe City as my first test of the Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: But I couldn't do it. Not with Jamie sleeping so peacefully.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Yes. I found my father in a government hospital.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: He was old, but his mind was sharp.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: First, I Snatched the Siberian search team

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: to secure a route for transporting the bioroids.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Another reason was Japanese culture itself,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: with its deep suspicion of others.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I gathered data and tried to find a solution.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: But nothing worked.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: As an insider, I could easily blow up the laboratory.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Everything went according to plan.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: My real struggle began afterward.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It was completely unexpected.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I'd spent forty years on that research.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: But a mistake put both you and Gillian in the government's hands.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What are you planning? This won't bring Jamie back!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I'm simply exploring what it means to be human.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Jamie may have inspired me once, but not anymore.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Isn't that just a scientist's arrogance?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Humans are fragile.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Even the strongest trust

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: crumbles under the slightest doubt.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Look how the Snatchers have shaken humanity.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: For all our scientific progress and lofty ideals,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: we still doubt, hate and kill each other.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Snatchers are merely tools that bring that out.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Through them, I simply reveal what lies within us.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I think this experiment has shown me humanity's limits.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Perhaps they can advance no further on their own.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: To evolve further, humanity needs a perfect leader.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: A resolute leader, unmoved by petty doubts.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: People will never follow Snatchers!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: They will if they don't know what their leaders are.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: People have always sought an absolute god.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Remove all doubt, and Snatchers can be their gods.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: A superior humanity made flesh.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I'm so close.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Once the artificial skin is complete,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Snatchers will surpass humanity and become true human beings.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Perfect artificial skin is impossible. Dr. Petrovich is dead.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I no longer need my father. I have a sample he made.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Once I've analyzed it,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I can mass-produce perfect artificial skin in any quantity I need.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Or I can simply culture the necessary cells: keratinocytes,

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: epithelial cells and pigment cells, then multiply them.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What are you talking about? Where's this perfect skin?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Look at this.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It was found in the ruins of Queen Hospital.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Randam!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Ah, so you do know him.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: He's a Snatcher?!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: That's not quite accurate.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: My father secretly built that bioroid in the likeness of his son. Me.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Here in this factory. He programmed it to destroy Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: That bioroid gave me no end of trouble.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It's far superior to my Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It believes it's human. He even gave it childhood memories. Ha!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Copies of my memories, of course.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: R-A-N-D-A-M H-A-J-I-L-E. Randam Hajile.
cues.note: #79: muted - the game spells RANDAM HAJILE / ELIJAH MADNAR in English letters across the box rows

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: E-L-I-J-A-H M-A-D-N-A-R. Elijah Madnar, backward.
cues.note: #79: muted - the game spells RANDAM HAJILE / ELIJAH MADNAR in English letters across the box rows

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Just like my father.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: That old fool easily made the skin I couldn't perfect in forty years.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: And a perfect bioroid that doesn't even know what it is.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: What's more, these cells regenerate themselves.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Supply them once, and there's no need

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: for further grafts of their own skin, or cultures.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Is he dead?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Its power and main systems have shut down. It's just scrap.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: But I've kept the precious artificial skin alive.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Now I can begin phase two of the Snatch Project:

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: full-scale infiltration of the world.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The summit's over. You won't get away with it.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: What does the summit matter?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: With perfect skin, nothing will hold us back.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: We can go anywhere, and no one will know.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie, are you all right?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Gillian! You came for me.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Are you hurt?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I'm all right. They won't hurt me.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: At least, not until their work

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: on perfect artificial skin is complete.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You're researching artificial skin?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: My memory's back. All of it.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What happened, Jamie?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: They threatened to kill him. To kill Harry.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: They forced me to help develop artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The doctor's condition was getting worse,

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: so they brought me here to take his place.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Gillian, Harry the mechanic is our son.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: He's lived alone for fifty years.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie, Harry's already...

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I had no choice. They threatened me. But I can't go on.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie!

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The doctor just died. He was over a hundred.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The three of us failed to escape: you, me and Elijah.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Elijah's pod was already empty when we were rescued.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Whose father? I don't understand. Jamie, you've lost me.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Elijah Madnar? The man in the chapel? The one who looked like Randam?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Randam?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: No, that's not him.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The doctor? That old man?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: All right? Stay calm and listen.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: A plan more horrifying than anyone could imagine.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Elijah Madnar is here, with the Snatchers...

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I'll tell you the rest.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Elijah? Is that you?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Madnar? This old man?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: You really can't remember anything?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Who the hell am I?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Gillian, was that your doing?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's impossible! I caused the Catastrophe?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Yes, Elijah is alive!

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: The project was going well.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It's me, Jamie.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: That's right, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I was in the CIA?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Who?!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: That's when I decided

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: to carry out the insane plan I'd been developing in secret.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Why make me say it, Jamie?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It was all because of you, Jamie. Your beauty.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: All I could do was watch from the shadows as you two grew closer.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Elijah, what happened to you?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: You were never capable of anything like this.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You and Gillian were to be sent back to your country.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Forty years have changed me, too.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You joined our project, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I wanted to be near you, Jamie.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: I can't believe it. Why?

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Harry.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Elijah.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Gillian!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Without my father's help, I decided to wake you.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: How could you? Half the world died because of you!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Three years ago, I finally completed my research.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: After ten years, Lucifer mutated naturally.
cues.ear_note: pitch 94 Hz = Madnar (Gillian 134); the script animates Gillian

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The vaccine, L-Angels, was already complete.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: That's so sad.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Of course, my father refused to help.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: But the automatic revival system didn't work.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Even sealed off, how did you avoid infection?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: But the test exposed a flaw in the artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: So that's why you brought Dr. Petrovich here.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Of course he refused. The doctor would never...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Lucifer Alpha.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Then all of it...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: How could you?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: The world will obey me. No one can stop me now.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Politics and ideology mean nothing.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: My will alone shall decide humanity's future.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: You're insane! You can't Snatch all of humanity!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: There's an automated Snatcher factory beneath the Kremlin.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: It's still producing new Snatchers.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: No matter what you do, you can't Snatch a human heart.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: What would any of this achieve?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Humanity is foolish, Jamie. But I'm different.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: I'm the savior of humanity. No, of all life on Earth!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'm afraid that won't happen.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: In ten minutes, a particle beam will strike this church.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'm guiding a killer satellite's beam here

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: with GPS and fifteen satellites. It won't miss.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Everything within several kilometers of me will be destroyed.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Stop this madness! You'll destroy my research!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You inferior analyzer!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, what did the summit decide?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Fearing the spread of Snatchers, every nation's delegates

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: unanimously authorized the use of nuclear weapons.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The military is sealing off the city.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: They're going to let the citizens die?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The citizens are panicking.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: But if the beam destroys this place, the blockade will be lifted.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This is our last chance.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll handle things here. Gillian, take Jamie and go.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: You insolent robot!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Move and I'll detonate! Hurry, Gillian!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal, don't!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I won't let a single Snatcher escape!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll destroy this artificial skin, too!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: A piece of junk like you?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: If you're the beam's target, we'll just carry you outside!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Get this runt out of here!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Stupid robot!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: What a nuisance!

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: What's happening?

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: How? You shouldn't be able to move!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: I don't know when to quit.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Impossible!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: You're dying with me. Don't fight it. Hey, Snatchers!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Keep your hands off the little guy, or I'll snap his neck!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Randam!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: I don't like being used. You and I will see the end together.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Five minutes, Gillian. The Tricycle's waiting outside. Get in it.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Let go! I'm Elijah Madnar! You're a copy of me!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Real or fake, we're both going to die here.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Once we're both dead, there won't be a fake anymore.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Just logic! A machine's programming!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: This is my choice!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: Machines have no will! They can't sacrifice themselves!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: You sure about that?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Four minutes. Get out, now!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Destroy the automated factory beneath the Kremlin.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Stop!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Gillian! Even if the memories in my head were made up...

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I know! Our memories of fighting together are real!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: There's no doubt about that!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: You've become a fine JUNKER, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I enjoyed working with you, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: If you can, recover my remains, like Little John's.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Little John? I understand!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Hurry! Three minutes!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I'm sorry. Both of you!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Let's go, Jamie!

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: No! Don't let her go! Jamie!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Pathetic. You don't even know how to love someone.

cues.speaker: Madnar
cues.en: What are you laughing at, machine?!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: By Snatching you, I'll take myself back.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Under a minute, Randam. It's all right now. Thank you.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Don't thank me. Sorry I dragged you into such a big job.

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: Well done. You're a fine JUNKER.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Three, two, one. Here it comes!

cues.speaker: Randam
cues.en: So long!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal!

cues.speaker: Announcer
cues.en: 5th Airborne Division, boarding complete. 7th Mechanized Infantry...

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: So you're really going.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: We're responsible, too.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: And going to the Kremlin might bring my memory back.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Then I could love you even more than I do now.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Wait for me. I'll destroy the factory beneath the Kremlin.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Let's live together when I get back, Jamie.

cues.speaker: Announcer
cues.en: 17th Special Operations Team, boarding complete.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Harry and I will be waiting for you.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Harry's hat.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: We'll make it work this time.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: A real marriage, with trust in each other.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I know, Jamie.

cues.speaker: Jamie
cues.en: Take care, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I'm off, Jamie.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Wait! Wait for me!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Take me with you!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal? Is that you?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Yes, it's me. They had no proper frame, so this body's temporary.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Call me Metal Gear PS.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Looks like your chip survived.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Randam shielded my chip from the beam.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Randam?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Take me with you, Gillian!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Please, please, please!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Hurry aboard, partner.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Right, Gillian!
